C2809: God sees the addressee when he stands and moves among those who bow down. Devils descend on every sinful liar, passing on what they overhear, mostly lies. Poets are followed by the misguided, roam every valley and say what they do not do, except believers who do good and defend themselves after being wronged. Wrongdoers will learn their fate.
C3358: Because a tribe enjoys its accustomed security and its familiar caravan journeys of winter and summer, let them worship the Lord of this house, who fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear.
C1895: Woe to every backbiting slanderer who piles up wealth and keeps counting it, imagining it will make him live forever. No: he will be flung into the Crusher. What is it? God's kindled fire, which rises over the hearts and is closed in upon them in outstretched columns.
C3537: Bliss glows on their faces; they drink sealed pure wine, its seal musk, mixed from a spring of those brought near. Let strivers compete for that. The guilty used to laugh at believers, wink as they passed and call them astray. Today believers laugh at the deniers, watching from couches: have they been repaid?
C2018: People are told to fear a day when no father can stand in for his child, nor child for father. God's promise is true; let neither worldly life nor the deceiver delude you. God alone knows the hour, sends rain and knows what wombs hold; no soul knows what it will earn tomorrow or where it will die.
C9513: Believers are told to fear God and speak straight words; He will mend their deeds and forgive their sins. The trust was offered to heavens, earth and mountains, which refused in fear; man took it up, unjust and ignorant. So God punishes hypocrites and idolaters, men and women, and relents toward believing men and women.
C1195: A man forgets his own creation and asks who can revive crumbled bones. Answer: the One who made them first, who gives you fire from the green tree. Can the maker of heavens and earth not create their like? He only tells a thing to be and it is. He holds all dominion; to Him you return.
C1907: Those given scripture split only after clear proof came, though commanded only to worship God sincerely, pray and give alms. Deniers among scripture people and idolaters abide in the fire, the worst of creatures. Believers who do good are the best; their reward is eternal gardens with rivers, God pleased with them and they with Him.
C9299: Read: your Lord is most generous, who taught by the pen what man did not know. Yet man transgresses, thinking himself self-sufficient. Consider one who forbids a servant to pray: does he not know God sees? If he does not stop he will be dragged by his lying forelock. Do not obey him; bow down and draw near.
C7689: God brings the second creation, enriches, is Lord of a bright star, destroyed ancient peoples leaving none, and overturned cities. Which of your Lord's favors do you doubt? This is a warner like earlier warners; the imminent event nears and only God can remove it. Do you marvel, laughing instead of weeping? Bow down to God and worship.
C1757: Whoever repents and does good truly returns to God. Those who give no false witness, pass idle talk with dignity, do not meet their Lord's signs deaf and blind, and pray for joy in spouses and offspring, are rewarded with a lofty chamber and greetings of peace, forever. Without your prayer my Lord would not care for you; you denied.
C5140: They glorify their Lord, whose promise is fulfilled, and fall on their faces weeping. Say: call on God or on the Merciful; whichever you use, His are the best names. Pray neither too loudly nor too quietly but in between. Say: praise to God, who has no child, no partner in rule, no protector out of weakness.
C3755: Do not gaze at the worldly splendor given some as a test; your Lord's provision is better. Bid your household pray; We ask no provision of you. They demand a sign, though proof came in earlier scrolls. Had We destroyed them first, they would have pleaded for a messenger. Say: all are waiting; you will learn who is rightly guided.
C4024: The God-fearing are led in groups to the garden; its gates open and its keepers greet them with peace, bidding them enter forever. They praise God for keeping His promise and letting them settle wherever they wish. Angels circle the throne glorifying their Lord; judgment is given in truth, and praise is said to the Lord of the worlds.
C4628: Those who believed, emigrated and strove, and those who sheltered and helped them, are one another's allies. Believers who have not emigrated get no protection until they do, yet must be helped in religion unless against a people under treaty. Deniers ally with each other. Later emigrants belong too, and blood relatives have first claim on each other.
C8469: They ask when this promise will come. Say: knowledge is with God; I am only a plain warner. When they see it near, deniers' faces fall. Say: whether God destroys me and my companions or shows us mercy, who will shield deniers from punishment? We trust the Merciful. If your water sank away, who would bring you flowing water?
C3041: Oaths by sun, moon, day, night, sky, earth, and the soul inspired with its wickedness and piety: whoever purifies it succeeds, whoever buries it fails. A people denied in arrogance; their most wretched rose, the messenger warned about God's she-camel and her drink, they hamstrung her, and their Lord crushed and leveled them, fearing no consequence.
C9935: Say to the deniers: I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship; I will never worship what you have worshipped, nor will you worship what I worship. You have your religion and I have mine.
C6029: All matters return to God. Believers: bow, prostrate, worship, do good. Strive for God as He deserves; He chose you and laid no hardship in religion, the way of your forefather, and named you those who submit, so the messenger witnesses over you and you over mankind. Pray, give alms, hold fast to God, best protector and helper.
C4676: When the hour comes the guilty swear they stayed only an hour. Those given knowledge and faith reply: you stayed until the day of raising, and this is it. No excuse helps wrongdoers then. Every kind of parable is in this scripture, yet deniers call any sign falsehood. Be patient; God's promise is true; let not the uncertain unsettle you.
C5467: Your Lord will judge their disputes on the day of rising. Is it no lesson how many generations were destroyed, in whose dwellings they walk? Do they not see water driven to barren land, bringing crops? They ask when the decision will come. Say: that day belief will not help deniers. Turn away and wait; they wait too.
C1784: Set your face to the upright religion; do not call on what can neither help nor harm. Harm from God none can remove but He; His bounty none can turn back. Say: truth has come from your Lord; whoever is guided or strays does so for or against himself; I am not your guardian. Be patient until God judges.
C5922: Believers are warned that among their spouses and children are enemies to beware of, yet pardoning meets God's forgiveness. Wealth and children are a trial; with God is great reward. Fear God as much as you can, listen, obey and spend; those guarded from their own greed succeed. A good loan to God He multiplies and forgives.
C1528: Bear patiently what they say; glorify your Lord before sunrise and sunset, at night and after prostrations. Listen for the day the caller calls from nearby and they hear the cry: the day of coming forth, when the earth splits and they hurry out. You are no tyrant over them; remind by this scripture whoever fears My warning.
C6385: The hour is their appointment, more grievous and bitter. The guilty will be dragged on their faces into fire. Everything is created by measure; Our command is one act, like the blink of an eye. We destroyed your likes. Every deed, small and great, is written. The pious are amid gardens and rivers, near a mighty King.
C9195: When God's help and victory come and you see people entering God's religion in crowds, glorify your Lord with praise and ask His forgiveness; He is ever accepting of repentance.
C9662: Do not gaze at what some of them enjoy nor grieve over them; be gentle to believers and say you are the plain warner. Those who tore this scripture into pieces will be questioned. Proclaim what you are commanded; We suffice you against the mockers. We know their words tighten your chest; glorify your Lord and worship until certainty comes.
C1189: O human, what deceived you about your generous Lord, who created, shaped and balanced you in whatever form He willed? Yet you deny the judgment, though noble recording guardians know what you do. The righteous will be in bliss, the wicked in blazing fire. What is judgment day? A day no soul can help another, and command is God's alone.
C1831: Do they not see that God, who created heavens and earth without tiring, can revive the dead? Deniers shown the fire will swear it is real and be told to taste punishment. Be patient like the resolute messengers and do not hasten it; when they see what was promised it will seem they stayed one hour of a day.
C1906: Why do the deniers rush toward you in clusters from right and left? Does each hope to enter a garden of bliss? No; they know what We made them from. We can replace them with better. Leave them to plunge and play until their promised day, when they hurry from graves as if racing to a marker, eyes downcast, humiliated.
C1112: A refrain of woe to the deniers recurs. This is the day of sorting; you and the ancients are gathered, try your scheme against Me. The pious are amid shade, springs and fruits, told to eat and drink for their deeds. The guilty may enjoy a little. Told to bow, they do not. What message will they believe after this?
C5012: For diseased hearts it adds filth to filth. Tested once or twice yearly, they neither repent nor take heed. When a chapter is sent down they glance at each other, ask if anyone sees them, and slip away. A messenger from among yourselves has come, pained by your hardship, kind to believers. If they turn away, say: God suffices me.
C9918: Your Lord knows you stand in prayer nearly two thirds of the night, or half, or a third, with some companions. Knowing you cannot keep count, He relents: recite what is easy of this scripture. Some will be sick, others travelling for livelihood, others fighting. So recite what is easy, pray, give alms, lend to God, and seek forgiveness.
C4021: They say that on returning to the city the mightier will drive out the lowlier; but might belongs to God, His messenger and the believers. Believers: let not wealth and children distract you from remembering God. Spend before death comes and one begs a short delay to give charity. God delays no soul once its term arrives.
C4543: Rivalry for more distracted you until you visited the graves. No, you will come to know; again, you will come to know. If only you knew with certain knowledge: you will surely see the blazing fire, see it with the eye of certainty, and then on that day be questioned about the pleasures you enjoyed.
C3536: God's example for deniers: the wives of two prophets, married to righteous servants, who betrayed them and were sent into the fire, their husbands unable to help. For believers: a tyrant's wife who prayed for a house near God in the garden and rescue from him, and a chaste woman into whom God breathed His spirit, who affirmed His words.
C7714: They answer: we did not pray, did not feed the poor, plunged into idle talk, and denied judgment day until certainty came. No intercession helps them. Why do they turn from the reminder like startled donkeys fleeing a lion? Each wants open scrolls for himself. It is a reminder; whoever wills heeds it, but only if God wills.
C1228: My task is only delivering God's messages; whoever disobeys has the fire forever. When they see what is promised they will know whose helpers are weaker and fewer. Say: I do not know if it is near or far. He reveals the unseen only to a chosen messenger, whom He surrounds with watchers to ensure delivery; He counts everything.
C9956: Say: truth has come; falsehood neither begins nor restores anything. If I stray it is my loss; if guided, it is by my Lord's revelation. See them terrified, with no escape, seized from close by, saying they believe; but how can they reach it from afar, having denied before? They are barred from what they desire, like doubters before them.
C8183: Do not think God will break His promise to His messengers. On the day earth and heavens are changed into others, all stand before God the One. You see the guilty chained, in garments of pitch, fire covering their faces, each soul repaid. This is a message to warn mankind that He is one God and make the thoughtful reflect.
C6433: Say: my prayer, sacrifice, living and dying are for God, without partner; I am first to submit. Should I seek another lord when He is Lord of everything? No soul bears another's burden; your Lord will settle your disputes. He made you successors on earth and raised some above others in rank to test you; swift in punishing, yet forgiving.
C4814: He boasts of squandering heaps of wealth. Does he think none saw him? Did We not give him eyes, tongue and lips and show him the two ways? Yet he has not attempted the steep path: freeing a slave, or feeding in famine an orphaned relative or someone destitute, and urging patience and compassion. Deniers have fire closed over them.
C4213: God has decreed that He and His messengers will prevail. No people believing in God and the last day befriend those who oppose God and His messenger, even fathers, sons, brothers or kin. He inscribed faith in their hearts and strengthened them with a spirit; He will admit them to gardens with rivers forever. They are God's party, the successful.
C3772: Whether We show you what We threaten or take you first, your duty is only to deliver; the reckoning is Ours. Do they not see We shrink the land from its edges? None reverses God's judgment. Earlier people schemed, but all scheming is God's. They say you are no messenger; say: God suffices as witness, and whoever knows scripture.
C5396: They ascribe a child to the Merciful, which ill befits Him; everyone in heaven and earth comes to Him as a servant, counted, each alone. For believers who do good He will appoint love. This was made easy in your tongue to gladden the pious and warn a contentious people. Of the generations destroyed before, can you hear a whisper?
C4230: Told that God's promise is true and the hour certain, you said you did not know what the hour is only guessing. What they mocked engulfs them. They are told: today We forget you as you forgot this meeting; the fire is your home, for you mocked God's signs and worldly life deceived you. Praise and majesty belong to God.
C4901: Remember your Lord's name morning and evening and glorify Him through the long night. These people love the fleeting life and neglect a heavy day ahead. We created them, strengthened them, and can replace them at will. This is a reminder; whoever wills takes a path to his Lord, but you will only as God wills. Wrongdoers face painful punishment.
C4098: An earlier scripture records that righteous servants will inherit the earth. You were sent only as mercy to the worlds. Say: your god is one God; will you submit? If they turn away: I have warned you all alike, not knowing whether the promise is near or far; perhaps it is a trial. He asks his Lord to judge truly.
C2419: Leave them to plunge and play until their promised day. He is God in heaven and on earth, owner of all between, who knows the hour. Those they invoke besides Him cannot intercede, except knowing witnesses to truth. Asked who created them they would say God. At the complaint that these people will not believe: turn away and say peace.
C8646: Except those your Lord has mercy on; His word stands that He will fill the fire with unseen spirits and humans together. The accounts of messengers are told to steady your heart, as truth and reminder for believers. Tell unbelievers: act your way, we act ours; wait, we are waiting. All returns to God; worship and rely on Him.
C4944: You love wealth intensely. No: when the earth is pounded to dust, your Lord comes with angels in ranks and the fire is brought near, man will remember, too late, wishing he had sent something ahead. None punishes or binds as He will that day. Then: O soul at peace, return to your Lord, pleased and pleasing; enter My garden.
C5468: There they hear no idle talk or lying: an ample reward from the Merciful, whom none may address. When the Spirit and angels stand in rows, only one permitted speaks, and rightly. Whoever wills takes a way to his Lord. A near punishment is warned, when each sees what his hands sent ahead and the denier wishes he were dust.
C6613: In two gardens are fruit, date palms and pomegranates; good and beautiful women, fair ones sheltered in pavilions, touched by neither human nor spirit; people reclining on green cushions and fine carpets. After each detail a refrain asks a pair of listeners which of their Lord's favors they will deny. It ends blessing the name of the Lord of majesty.
C8542: True believers are only those who believe in God and His messenger without then doubting, and strive with wealth and lives in God's cause. Say: would you inform God about your religion, when He knows everything? They count their submission a favor to you; say: rather God favored you by guiding you to faith. God sees what you do.
C4282: He brings out pasture, then makes it dark stubble. You will be made to recite without forgetting, your way eased. Remind: the fearful will heed; the most wretched will shun it and enter the great fire, neither dying nor living. Whoever purifies himself and prays succeeds. You prefer worldly life, though the hereafter is better; so say the earliest scrolls.
C8423: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whisperer who slinks away, who whispers into people's breasts, whether from among unseen spirits or from among people.
C7098: Have they not travelled and seen the end of those before them, more numerous and stronger? Their gains did not help. When messengers brought clear proofs they exulted in their knowledge, and what they mocked engulfed them. Seeing Our might, they professed belief in God alone, but belief then did not help. Such is God's way; the deniers lost.
